newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market midession report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market midession report.

text.p: Swiss franc bonds were firm at Tuesday's midsession on rising volume, with March Confederate bond futures hitting a new contract high.
Declines in swap rates and a firmer Swiss franc supported prices. Swiss labour market figures Monday helped to allay fears about any tightening.
The market was seen relatively lacking in supply, which helped to push prices higher.
The March Conf was up 48 basis points at 120.30 in early afternoon, compared with an earlier high at 120.60, which was also the contract high.
